scope: Selected canonical DamageByAttackProperty requests with AttackType=DOT, a DamagePercentage payload, an allowed ByAttack/ByMaxHP/ByDefence initial formula, and no direct value, Break, inheritance, stance, split or special state fields.
selected_model: A selected DOT request is a periodic damage tick only: calculate the existing initial damage formula, apply the existing universal/DEF/RES/vulnerability/final-damage chain with crit rate fixed to zero, then commit through shield before CurrentHP. It neither applies nor refreshes a DoT modifier, rolls application chance, changes toughness, nor expires a modifier.
ordering: This selected tick creates DOT_DAMAGE_COMMITTED in canonical sibling order. Its survival commit completes before the next sibling. DoT lifecycle scheduling is explicitly outside this packet.

evidence.support: initial/mitigation formula chain and ordered shield-before-HP boundary
real canonical DOT component reaches an independently specified no-crit transition

unsupported_boundary: damage tags, inheritance, reflection, split/AOE sequencing
dsh_implementation_contract: Keep DOT ticks separate from ordinary direct damage and modifier lifecycle. Apply no crit factor. Reuse shield-before-HP only after the DOT tick amount is selected. Reject all non-selected mixed payloads rather than treating them as ordinary DOT.
